> 第1章 穿越（第1页）
一位身材魁梧的男子抱着一箱武术器材转头问着一位身穿武术服腰上缠着黑色腰带的少女。
准备离开武术馆的少女闻言转头向男子挥了挥手：“不了秦叔，明天要回学校拍毕业照，还要和我室友吃饭一时半会赶不回来。”
便提着伞头也不回的冲入了雨夜中。
看着少女疾冲冲的身影消失在雨幕中，男子摇摇头：“唉，还是那么急急躁躁。”
楚安芷在雨夜中疾步走，想着快点回家洗个热水澡，就可以躺在床上追小说了。
正美滋滋的想着，就在这时刺耳的刹车声撕裂了雨夜，路人的惊叫声在耳边炸开。
视野里只有那只在马路中央、被刺目远光灯笼罩的小猫，以及那个跌跌撞撞想去救小猫的小小身影。
身体比意识更快一步，她像离弦的箭，猛地向人行道冲了出去，用尽全力将那吓傻的小孩和那小猫狠狠丢到了路边的绿化带。
而她因巨大的冲击力和小孩和猫的重量失去了平衡，踉跄着暴露在疾驰而来的汽车面前。
意识的最后，恍惚间，她似乎听到了路人惊恐的尖叫、救护车由远及近的鸣笛…………还有孩子撕心裂肺的哭声。
一丝微弱的、几乎被痛苦淹没的释然浮上心头。
代价是身体深处不断涌上的冰冷和黑暗将她淹没。
而在另一个世界，观世宗一间洞府的石床上一位女子猛的睁开了眼睛。
女子猛的坐起，眼底还残留着对车灯和剧痛的惊悸。
楚安芷抬头望去就看见一个长相清冷，但有一双含情桃花眼的清丽少女。
少女看到楚安芷一直在看她，脸微微开始泛红，她猛地站了起来，头也不回的朝外跑：“师姑！
我去告诉师尊他们你醒了这个好消息。”
楚安芷看着她跑走的身影，伸出了尔康手：“不是，谁能告诉我现在是什么情况，这是把我干哪来了。”
当然已经跑远的少女根本没听到楚安芷的求助。
就在这时，楚安芷的脑袋剧痛，迟来的记忆开始攻击她。
吸收完记忆的楚安芷无语望天，额……不是，无语望洞顶，留下两条宽面条泪，Ber，这怎么救个人就把自己干穿书了呢？
还是穿成了反派楚未的恶毒师尊啊！
她可是为了修炼把自家徒弟当炉鼎的。

> Chapter 1 Time Travel (Page 1)
A burly man holding a box of martial arts equipment turned to ask a girl in martial arts uniform with a black belt around her waist.
The girl who was about to leave the martial arts hall turned around and waved to the man when she heard this: "No, Uncle Qin, I have to go back to school tomorrow to take graduation photos, and I have to have dinner with my roommate. I won't be back for a while."
He held an umbrella and rushed into the rainy night without looking back.
Seeing the girl's dashing figure disappearing into the rain, the man shook his head: "Oh, I'm still so impatient."
Chu Anzhi walked quickly in the rainy night, thinking that she could go home quickly and take a hot bath so that she could lie in bed and read novels.
Just as he was thinking happily, the harsh sound of brakes tore through the rainy night, and the screams of passers-by exploded in his ears.
All he could see was the kitten in the middle of the road, shrouded in dazzling high beams, and the little figure stumbling to save the kitten.
Her body was one step faster than her consciousness. She rushed out to the sidewalk like an arrow, and used all her strength to throw the frightened child and the kitten into the green belt on the roadside.
Due to the huge impact and the weight of the child and cat, she lost her balance and staggered, exposed in front of the speeding car.
At the end of her consciousness, in a daze, she seemed to hear the terrified screams of passers-by, the sirens of ambulances approaching from far away... and the heart-wrenching cries of children.
A faint, almost painful relief came over me.
The price was that the coldness and darkness that kept rising deep in her body overwhelmed her.
In another world, a woman suddenly opened her eyes on a stone bed in a cave of Guanshi Sect.
The woman sat up suddenly, the shock of the headlights and severe pain still lingering in her eyes.
Chu Anzhi looked up and saw a beautiful girl with a cold appearance but a pair of loving peach blossom eyes.
When the girl saw that Chu Anzhi had been looking at her, her face started to turn red slightly. She stood up suddenly and ran out without looking back: "Sister-in-law!
I'll go tell Master and them the good news that you've woken up. "
Chu Anzhi looked at her running figure and stretched out her hand: "No, who can tell me what the situation is now and what happened to me."
Of course, the girl who had run away didn't even hear Chu Anzhi's plea for help.
At this moment, Chu Anzhi's head hurt violently, and belated memories began to attack her.
After absorbing the memory, Chu Anzhi looked at the sky speechlessly, uh... No, she looked at the roof of the cave speechlessly, leaving two lasagna tears, Bir, how can you save someone and fuck yourself through the book?
Or the vicious master who disguised himself as the villain Chu Wei!
She used her apprentice as a furnace for the sake of cultivation.
